cockpit.name: 🚲 龍頭、車把與座管系統
items: • **龍頭前叉上管鎖緊螺栓**：4–5 N·m（雙釘需交替分次鎖緊，碳纖維前叉舵管務必塗抹止滑膏，嚴禁超扭，內部膨脹吊芯預緊約 6–8 N·m）
• **龍頭前蓋（把橫鎖緊）**：4–5 N·m（四釘對角線十字交叉鎖緊，保持上下/左右縫隙均勻，碳把橫塗抹止滑膏）
• **一體把底部碼表架固定螺栓**：2–3 N·m（螺紋極淺易滑牙，建議塗微量中強度螺絲膠）
• **座管束環 / 隱藏式楔形膨脹塊**：4–6 N·m（以車架或座管標稱上限為準，碳纖維座管務必塗抹止滑膏，切勿使用普通黃油）
• **座墊夾頭鎖緊螺栓**：單螺栓通常 9–12 N·m；前後雙螺栓通常 5–7 N·m

drivetrain.name: ⚙️ 大盤、中軸、曲柄與踏板
items: • **Shimano 曲柄左臂夾緊螺栓**：12–14 N·m（雙螺栓必須交替分次鎖緊，鎖緊前確認防脫安全插片已壓入位）
• **Shimano 曲柄側向預壓塑膠蓋**：0.7–1.5 N·m（僅用專用梅花工具指力旋緊消除軸向游隙，嚴禁死鎖加重軸承阻力）
• **SRAM DUB 曲柄自拔主螺栓**：54 N·m（鎖緊扭力極大，螺紋與墊圈接觸面務必塗抹高壓潤滑脂，預壓環最後消除游隙）
• **公路車踏板安裝**：35–40 N·m（螺紋塗抹防卡膏或抗磨黃油；注意：右腳為正牙順時針鎖緊，左腳為反牙逆時針鎖緊）
• **SRAM 爪盤直裝螺栓 (Direct Mount)**：8 釘 T25 為 4 N·m；3 釘 T25 為 8–9 N·m（帶螺絲膠）

brakes_wheels.name: 💿 碟煞、飛輪與輪組系統
items: • **中央鎖死碟盤鎖緊環**：40 N·m（內齒使用飛輪套筒，外齒使用外掛中軸套筒，螺紋塗微量黃油防咬死）
• **六孔碟盤固定螺絲 (M5 T25)**：2–4 N·m（Shimano/SRAM 官方規範為 2–4 N·m，標準建議 4 N·m。嚴禁打到 5–6 N·m 導致螺絲滑牙或碟盤盤片受力形變微偏擺！對角星形分次交替鎖緊，務必使用帶有中強度防鬆膠的專用螺栓）
• **卡式飛輪鎖緊蓋**：40 N·m（使用專用飛輪套筒鎖緊，確認最小片齒圈已完全吻合卡槽）
• **平裝式 (Flat Mount) 碟煞卡鉗螺栓**：6–8 N·m（車架螺紋多為鋁合金，嚴禁超扭，需塗中強度螺絲膠）
• **公路車貫通軸 / 桶軸桿 (Thru Axle)**：9–13.5 N·m（通常標稱 10 N·m，軸身與螺紋塗微量潤滑脂防異音）

derailleurs.name: 🔄 變速器與勾爪系統
items: • **車架後變勾爪固定小螺絲**：2–3 N·m（螺紋極細，務必塗抹中強度螺絲膠）
• **後變速器主固定螺栓**：8–10 N·m（螺紋塗抹潤滑脂，確認止動墊片貼合勾爪台階）
• **直裝式前變速器固定螺栓**：5–7 N·m（碳纖維防爆片放平，前變支撐頂絲需確實頂住車架加固鐵片）
• **煞車變速一體把手抱箍**：6–8 N·m（碳纖維把橫塗抹止滑膏，手把受撞擊時應允許微幅位移防斷把）

BSA.name: BSA 英規螺紋五通（殼體寬 68mm，螺紋直徑 1.37英吋）
BSA.SHIMANO_24:
✅ **適配中軸型號**：Shimano SM-BBR60 / BB-R9100 或第三方外掛 BSA-24
🔧 **五通寬度**：68mm
⚙️ **墊圈配置**：公路車 68mm 規格兩側均**無需**五通外襯墊圈
🔨 **所需工具**：Shimano TL-FC32 / TL-FC25 / TL-FC24 外掛中軸 16 槽套筒
💡 **技師注意**：驅動側為反牙（順時針鬆，逆時针緊），非驅動側為正牙。
BSA.SRAM_DUB:
✅ **適配中軸型號**：SRAM DUB BSA 68 Road
🔧 **五通寬度**：68mm
⚙️ **墊圈配置**：標準公路車通常在右側（驅動側）曲柄軸心套入 1 枚 **4.5mm** 外軸心墊圈
🔨 **所需工具**：SRAM DUB 專用戶外 12 槽 / 24 槽大口徑中軸套筒
💡 **技師注意**：螺紋塗抹重載黃油，左右中軸鎖緊扭力 35–40 N·m。
BSA.ROTOR_30:
✅ **適配中軸型號**：BSA30 外掛中軸（如 Rotor BSA30、Wheels Mfg BSA30）
🔧 **五通寬度**：68mm
⚙️ **墊圈配置**：依 30mm 軸心總長度搭配專用階梯墊圈
🔨 **所需工具**：外徑 48.5mm / 16 槽大號中軸套筒（區別於常規 44mm Shimano 工具）

BB86.name: BB86 壓入式五通（殼體寬 86.5mm，五通內徑 41mm，常見於 Giant、Canyon等）
BB86.SHIMANO_24:
✅ **適配中軸型號**：BB86 壓入式中軸（Shimano SM-BB72-41B / SM-BB92-41B）
🔧 **五通規格**：寬 86.5mm，內徑 41mm
⚙️ **墊圈配置**：中軸兩端直接壓入五通到底，公路 24mm 軸心無需任何額外墊圈
🔨 **所需工具**：壓入式中軸壓入工具（帶 24mm 導向塊）+ 拆卸敲擊棒/特工
💡 **技師注意**：壓入時外殼塗抹微量黃油防擠壓異音，嚴禁敲打軸承內圈！
BB86.SRAM_DUB:
✅ **適配中軸型號**：SRAM DUB PressFit Road 86.5 (PF41-DUB)
🔧 **五通規格**：寬 86.5mm，內徑 41mm
⚙️ **墊圈配置**：驅動側（右側）需安裝 **3mm** 軸心外墊圈
⚠️ **技師警告**：五通內徑僅 41mm，塞入 28.99mm 軸心後，滾珠空間極其狹小！壽命通常短於 24mm 中軸，建議定期清理泥沙或選用優質互鎖中軸。
BB86.ROTOR_30:
✅ **適配中軸型號**：4130 壓入式中軸
⚠️ **技師警告**：41mm 孔徑容納 30mm 軸心會導致培林滾珠直徑極小，耐久度較低，重度抽車易出現異音或微小晃動。

T47_IN.name: T47 內藏式螺紋五通（殼體寬 85.5/86.5mm，M47×1.0 螺紋，常見於 Trek、Factor等）
T47_IN.SHIMANO_24:
✅ **適配中軸型號**：T47 Internal 24mm（如 Wheels Mfg、Token、Tripeak）
🔧 **五通規格**：螺紋外徑約 47mm，杯體完全隱入五通內部
⚙️ **墊圈配置**：Trek 85.5mm 規格通常搭配專屬內襯墊圈或原廠間隙微調環
🔨 **所需工具**：T47 內置多槽專屬中軸套筒
💡 **技師注意**：五通內走線管務必使用保護套管隔開，防止軸心旋轉摩擦管線！
T47_IN.SRAM_DUB:
✅ **適配中軸型號**：SRAM DUB T47 (Internal 85.5 / 86.5 Road)
🔧 **五通寬度**：85.5mm 或 86.5mm
⚙️ **墊圈配置**：驅動側通常搭配 2.5mm 或 3.0mm 軸心外墊圈（依車架五通淨寬微調）
🔨 **所需工具**：T47 內置專用 12 槽/16 槽套筒
💡 **技師注意**：螺紋務必塗滿特種潤滑脂或防卡膏，鎖緊扭力 35–40 N·m。

PF30.name: PF30 壓入式五通（殼體寬 68mm，五通內徑 46mm，常見於 Cannondale、Specialized等）
PF30.SHIMANO_24:
✅ **適配中軸型號**：PF30 轉 24mm 對鎖中軸（Wheels Mfg / Token Ninja / Wishbone）
🔧 **五通規格**：寬 68mm，內徑 46mm
⚙️ **墊圈配置**：強烈推薦使用左右“螺紋對鎖式 (Thread-together)”中軸，徹底根治壓入式游隙異音！
🔨 **所需工具**：雙側對鎖專用扳手或壓入工具。
PF30.SRAM_DUB:
✅ **適配中軸型號**：SRAM DUB PF30 Road 68mm
🔧 **五通規格**：寬 68mm，內徑 46mm
⚙️ **墊圈配置**：驅動側需安裝 **4.5mm** 軸心外墊圈
🔨 **所需工具**：壓入工具搭配 29mm DUB 壓塊。

chain_formula.name: 公路車雙盤標準鏈條節數計算（Rigout 嚴格算法）
chain_formula.note: 其中 C = 車架後下叉長度(mm)，F = 大盤最大盤齒數，R = 飛輪最大齒數。計算結果若為單數需加 1 湊成偶數節。⚠️ 本公式嚴格適用於公路車雙盤 (2x) 系統；若為單盤 (1x) 系統，因後撥導臂張力範圍差異，請採用官方繞大盤大飛加 4 節之實測法。

tubeless_sealant.note: 夏季高溫蒸發較快建議多補 5–10ml；補胎液壽命通常為 2–4 個月，到期請及時檢查補充以防乾涸失效！

captcha_questions.q: 拆卸公路車【右側（驅動側）】踏板時，扳手應該向哪個方向旋轉鬆開？
options: 逆時針方向（向車尾方向板）
順時針方向（向車頭方向板）

captcha_questions.q: 拆卸公路車【左側（非驅動側）】踏板時，扳手應該向哪個方向旋轉鬆開？
options: 順時針方向（向車尾方向板，反牙）
逆時針方向（向車頭方向板）

captcha_questions.q: Shimano R8170 / R9270 這一代油壓碟煞系統必須使用哪種煞車油？
options: 專用礦物油（Mineral Oil，通常為粉紅色）

captcha_questions.q: SRAM AXS eTap 油壓碟煞卡鉗換油時，使用的是哪種煞車制動液？
組裝全碳纖維把橫、座管時，接觸面應塗抹什麼以防滑並降低所需鎖緊扭力？
options: 碳纖維止滑膏 (Carbon Friction Paste)

captcha_questions.q: Shimano 24mm 軸心曲柄左臂上的兩顆夾緊螺栓，正確的緊固方式是？
options: 兩顆螺栓交替分次鎖緊至 12–14 N·m
先將其中一顆一次性鎖到底
完全憑手感鎖緊不用管扭力

captcha_questions.q: 中央鎖死碟盤鎖緊環的標準推薦扭力通常是多少？
無內胎（真空胎）公路車，補胎液通常建議多長時間檢查或補注一次？

tubeless.label: 🥛 無內胎補胎液檢查
tubeless.desc: 補胎液易乾涸結塊，滿90天需晃動輪組聽液體聲或拆開補注。

chain_wax.label: 🕯️ 鏈條熱浸蠟/補蠟保養
chain_wax.desc: 蠟膜乾燥潤滑清潔，雨戰後或每兩週需重新浸蠟或補滴固蠟。

brake_bleed.label: 🩸 油壓碟煞換油與排氣
brake_bleed.desc: DOT油吸水變質易產生氣阻，礦物油乳化渾濁，建議每年徹底換油排氣一次。

cockpit.name: 🚲 Cockpit & Seatpost System
items: • **Stem Steerer Clamp Bolts**: 4–5 N·m (Alternate tightening, always apply carbon friction paste on carbon steerers; expander plug pre-tightened to 6–8 N·m)
• **Stem Faceplate Bolts**: 4–5 N·m (Cross/X-pattern tightening, keep upper/lower gaps even; apply friction paste on carbon handlebars)
• **Integrated Handlebar Out-front Mount**: 2–3 N·m (Very shallow threads, apply light threadlocker, do not over-torque)
• **Seatpost Clamp / Wedge**: 4–6 N·m (Refer to frame/post markings; always use carbon assembly paste, never standard grease)
• **Saddle Rail Clamp**: Single bolt: 9–12 N·m; Dual bolts (front/rear): 5–7 N·m

drivetrain.name: ⚙️ Crankset, BB, Pedals & Spindle
items: • **Shimano Left Crank Pinch Bolts**: 12–14 N·m (Alternate tightening incrementally; ensure safety plate is fully engaged before locking)
• **Shimano Crank Preload End Cap**: 0.7–1.5 N·m (Finger-tighten with tool to remove axial play; do not over-tighten to cause bearing drag)
• **SRAM DUB Self-Extracting Main Bolt**: 54 N·m (Heavy torque! Apply heavy-duty assembly grease on threads and washer; eliminate play with adjuster ring)
• **Road Bike Pedals**: 35–40 N·m (Grease threads; Drive-side: clockwise to tighten; Non-drive side: counter-clockwise/reverse thread)
• **SRAM Direct Mount Chainring**: 8-bolt T25: 4 N·m; 3-bolt T25: 8–9 N·m (with threadlocker)

brakes_wheels.name: 💿 Disc Brakes, Cassette & Wheels
items: • **Centerlock Rotor Lockring**: 40 N·m (Internal spline uses cassette tool; External spline uses BB tool; lightly grease threads)

• **6-Bolt Disc Rotor Bolts (M5 T25)**: 2–4 N·m (Shimano/SRAM official spec is 2–4 N·m, standard 4 N·m. Never exceed 4.5 N·m to avoid sheared bolts or rotor warping; tighten in cross/star pattern with medium threadlocker)
• **Cassette Lockring**: 40 N·m (Ensure smallest 11T/12T cog splines are fully engaged before torquing)
• **Flat Mount Disc Brake Caliper Bolts**: 6–8 N·m (Frame threads are alloy, never over-torque; apply medium threadlocker)
• **Road Thru-Axles**: 9–13.5 N·m (Typically 10 N·m; apply thin layer of grease on threads and shaft)

derailleurs.name: 🔄 Derailleurs & Hanger
items: • **Rear Derailleur Hanger Fixing Bolt**: 2–3 N·m (Fine thread, apply medium threadlocker)
• **Rear Derailleur Mounting Bolt**: 8–10 N·m (Grease thread; ensure b-screw tab aligns with hanger notch)
• **Braze-on Front Derailleur Bolt**: 5–7 N·m (Ensure backing plate sits flat and support screw contacts frame protector)
• **STI Brake/Shift Lever Clamp**: 6–8 N·m (Use carbon paste; should slip slightly under hard crash impact to protect handlebar)

BSA.name: BSA Threaded (Shell 68mm, 1.37" x 24 TPI)
BSA.SHIMANO_24:
✅ **Compatible BB**: Shimano SM-BBR60 / BB-R9100 or BSA-24 external
🔧 **Shell Width**: 68mm
⚙️ **Spacer Setup**: Standard road 68mm needs **NO** external shell spacers
🔨 **Tool**: Shimano TL-FC32 / TL-FC25 16-notch socket
💡 **Note**: Drive side is reverse thread (turn clockwise to loosen).
BSA.SRAM_DUB:
✅ **Compatible BB**: SRAM DUB BSA 68 Road
🔧 **Shell Width**: 68mm
⚙️ **Spacer Setup**: Typically install **1x 4.5mm** outer spacer on the drive-side spindle
🔨 **Tool**: SRAM DUB 12/24-notch socket
💡 **Note**: Grease threads thoroughly; torque to 35–40 N·m.
BSA.ROTOR_30:
✅ **Compatible BB**: BSA30 External BB (Rotor BSA30, Wheels Mfg BSA30)
🔧 **Shell Width**: 68mm
⚙️ **Spacer Setup**: Match stepped spacers according to 30mm spindle effective length
🔨 **Tool**: 48.5mm / 16-notch oversize BB socket

BB86.name: BB86 PressFit (Shell 86.5mm, ID 41mm, Giant/Canyon/etc.)
BB86.SHIMANO_24:
✅ **Compatible BB**: BB86 PressFit (Shimano SM-BB72-41B / SM-BB92-41B)
🔧 **Shell**: 86.5mm width, 41mm ID
⚙️ **Spacer Setup**: Press in cups flush; road 24mm spindle requires no extra spacers
🔨 **Tool**: Press tool with 24mm guides + bearing puller/punch tool
💡 **Note**: Lightly grease outer shell to prevent creaks; never press on bearing inner races!
BB86.SRAM_DUB:
✅ **Compatible BB**: SRAM DUB PressFit Road 86.5 (PF41-DUB)
🔧 **Shell**: 86.5mm width, 41mm ID
⚙️ **Spacer Setup**: Drive-side requires **3mm** outer spindle spacer
⚠️ **Mechanic Warning**: 41mm shell ID leaves very little room for 28.99mm spindle, resulting in small bearing balls. Shorter lifespan than 24mm; keep clean and inspect regularly.
BB86.ROTOR_30:
✅ **Compatible BB**: 4130 PressFit BB
⚠️ **Mechanic Warning**: 30mm spindle in 41mm shell forces extremely small balls; lower bearing durability under heavy sprinting.

T47_IN.name: T47 Internal Threaded (Shell 85.5/86.5mm, M47x1.0, Trek/Factor/etc.)
T47_IN.SHIMANO_24:
✅ **Compatible BB**: T47 Internal 24mm (Wheels Mfg, Token, Tripeak)
🔧 **Shell**: ~47mm thread diameter, cups fit flush inside the BB shell
⚙️ **Spacer Setup**: Trek 85.5mm typically uses internal sleeve or micro-adjusters
🔨 **Tool**: T47 internal multi-notch tool
💡 **Note**: Use protective sleeve over internal cables to avoid friction with spinning spindle!
T47_IN.SRAM_DUB:
✅ **Compatible BB**: SRAM DUB T47 (Internal 85.5 / 86.5 Road)
🔧 **Shell**: 85.5mm or 86.5mm width
⚙️ **Spacer Setup**: Drive side usually takes 2.5mm or 3.0mm outer spacer
🔨 **Tool**: T47 internal 12/16-notch socket
💡 **Note**: Grease threads thoroughly; tighten to 35–40 N·m.
T47_IN.ROTOR_30:
✅ **Compatible BB**: T47 Internal 30mm
🔧 **Shell**: 85.5mm / 86.5mm
🔨 **Tool**: T47 internal tool

PF30.name: PF30 PressFit (Shell 68mm, ID 46mm, Cannondale/Specialized/etc.)
PF30.SHIMANO_24:
✅ **Compatible BB**: PF30 to 24mm Thread-together BB (Wheels Mfg / Token Ninja / Wishbone)
🔧 **Shell**: 68mm width, 46mm ID
⚙️ **Recommendation**: Highly recommend thread-together BB to permanently solve PF30 creaking!
🔨 **Tool**: Dual thread-together BB wrenches.
PF30.SRAM_DUB:
✅ **Compatible BB**: SRAM DUB PF30 Road 68mm
🔧 **Shell**: 68mm width, 46mm ID
⚙️ **Spacer Setup**: Drive side requires **4.5mm** outer spacer
🔨 **Tool**: Press tool with 29mm DUB drift adapters.

chain_formula.name: Road Double Chain Length Calculation (Rigout Formula)
chain_formula.note: C = Chainstay length (mm), F = Big chainring teeth, R = Max cassette cog teeth. Always round up to an even number. ⚠️ Rigout formula strictly applies to 2x double drivetrain systems; for 1x single chainrings, use manufacturer big-big + 4 links physical sizing method.

tubeless_sealant.note: Hot summers cause faster evaporation (+5-10ml suggested). Sealant lasts 2–4 months; check regularly to prevent drying out!

captcha_questions.q: When removing the [Right / Drive-side] pedal on a road bike, which direction should you turn the wrench?
When removing the [Left / Non-drive-side] pedal on a road bike, which direction should you turn the wrench?
options: Clockwise (toward the rear wheel, reverse thread)

captcha_questions.q: Which brake fluid MUST be used in Shimano R8170 / R9270 hydraulic disc brakes?
Which brake fluid is used in SRAM AXS eTap road hydraulic disc brakes?
What should be applied to carbon handlebars and seatposts to prevent slipping and reduce required torque?
What is the proper method to tighten the two left crank arm pinch bolts on a Shimano crank?
options: Alternate incrementally between both bolts to 12–14 N·m

captcha_questions.q: What is the standard recommended torque for a centerlock rotor lockring?
How often should tubeless sealant in road bike tires typically be checked or topped up?

tubeless.label: 🥛 Tubeless Sealant Check
tubeless.desc: Sealant dries up over time. Check or replenish every 90 days.

chain_wax.label: 🕯️ Chain Hot Wax / Drip Wax
chain_wax.desc: Clean & dry lubrication. Re-wax every 2 weeks or after wet rides.

brake_bleed.label: 🩸 Hydraulic Brake Bleed & Fluid Flush
brake_bleed.desc: DOT fluid absorbs moisture and mineral oil degrades. Annual flush recommended.
